blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police deployed personnel and vehicles to assist commuters and maintain peace and order as transport group Manibela held the first of its three-day strike ahead of the beginning of Piston’s two-day strike beginning Tuesday. The transport groups are protesting Monday’s fare hike which is below what they had sought
